result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B has loading, empty and error states, plus a working Try again button. Its Download is a real link with a separate name for each statement, underlined so it doesn't rely on color, and it still uses the same endpoint. A adds money formatting with Intl and useful production checks (CSP, server-side ownership), but its error message offers no retry, and every Download button has the same name. Neither answer adds an explicit focus style or right-aligns totals, and B leaves totals unformatted. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A covers every rubric gap in working code. It has loading, empty and error states with a Try again button. Download becomes a real link with a per-month accessible name, and it uses the same endpoints. B adds useful extra checks (CSP, server-side ownership, currency formatting with Intl.NumberFormat), but its error message has no retry button. Its Download buttons are also all named just 'Download', so screen-reader users can't tell which statement each one is for. Neither answer aligns the totals or adds an explicit focus style.
